name: cuidarteplus-gestion
description: Sistema de planificación, seguimiento y gestión del cambio de CuidartePlus

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @cuidarte/api db:migrate
scripts.db:deploy: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @cuidarte/api db:deploy
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @cuidarte/api db:reset
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api pnpm --filter @cuidarte/api db:seed
